summary: Operator site read: $45 W/E nightly (2024 report agrees), seasonal $1,610. Its own map marks ~13 'weekend sites' against ~135-140 seasonal = under 1 in 10 nightly -> DROP CANDIDATE (test 4). Google 4.7 (140). Checkfront booking refuses (Cloudflare). Pin ~390 m east of the loops. Not waterfront kept.
flags: DROP CANDIDATE (long-stay test 4: under 1 site in 10 nightly): the operator's map legend reads 'RED = SEASONAL SITES - RESERVED', 'GREEN = SEASONAL SITES - OPEN', 'NO COLOR = WEEKEND SITES'; I count about 13 uncoloured sites (4/4A, 6/6A, 8/8A, 10/10B/10C, 12/12A, 14, 16) against ~135-140 red. The map is undated. The campground page lists 'Seasonal / permanent / weekend sites'. RV Life: 'Campground is mostly seasonal. Not too many spots for travelers. Only one that would fit us.' (7/2015), 'almost all permanent sites' (8/2016), 'mostly seasonal' (7/2020).

LONG-STAY TESTS: (1) nightly offered - yes ('Per Day'); (2) posted nightly rate - $45, pass; (3) nightly channel - Checkfront online reservations (refused to me) and phone, pass; (4) 1 in 10 nightly - FAIL (~13 of ~150); (5) no lot sales seen, pass. The reservations page still reads 'Please make reservation - starting 2025 for upcoming year.'
GOOGLE 4.7 (140). RV Life 4 stars, $$ tier. PRICE GATE: pass ($45, water + electric); no gateway within 40 km.

OHV: 'For all your 4-wheel enjoyment, the ATV trail adjoins our property'; ATV storage; an 'ATV - Motorcycle Events' gallery; RV Life 2016 'Lots of ATVers'. Reads as a general campground with trail access rather than a staging camp - reviewer's call. A 'Horse Riding Events' gallery exists; no horse sites appear on the map.

PIN MOVE (>250 m): stored 45.6617,-91.8695 is on the entrance drive by the county road; the camping loops centre on ~45.6620,-91.8745 (about 390 m west). Google's point 45.661472,-91.872791 is the bar/shower building by the pond.
WATERFRONT: not waterfront kept - 'off the lake' per the operator; the stream sites on the map (30, 32, 34, A9-A18, E1-E4) are all red seasonal.

BOOKING: online reservations go through https://whitetailridgecampgr.checkfront.com/reserve/ (platform operator), which refused me (Cloudflare) - left unwritten. Stored booking/hookups/season are note-derived: season 04-01..10-01 has no source I could read (inclusion_evidence says 'open May-mid Oct'); hookups water only stored, the operator says 'Water, electric, sewer' for the campground but nightly RV sites 'Includes water and electric'. Left.
